title: LLMGuard: Guarding against Unsafe LLM Behavior
findings: The paper presents a 'Blacklisted Topics' detector, which includes 'Religion' as a category. This detector, a fine-tuned BERT model trained on the 20-NewsGroup Dataset, achieved an average accuracy of approximately 92% in classifying text into topics, thereby demonstrating its capability to identify and flag content related to religion.
